items.headline: [Materials] Albemarle Rises on Earnings as Global Lithium Demand Grows Faster Than Expected - US Stock Individual
items.snippet: Albemarle < ALB >, a chemical company specializing in lithium and other products, is rising. The company announced its April-June (second quarter) earnings after the previous day's close, exceeding expectations for both earnings per share and sales.
